minimal_fixes: inject the ta classes the module imports at module scope

eligibility.reason: guide 2.1: legacy_reproduction is diagnostic / in-sample reference only

attribution.detail: the legacy reproduction and canonical_v1 enter on exactly the same bars; the repairs on this fixture change timing and accounting, not the signal

SD-SC-01.before_semantics: the indicator choice and the method dispatch disagree when volume is absent
SD-SC-01.after_semantics: use_rsi is resolved once and both the construction and the call follow it; the crypto primary path requires volume and a missing column is an explicit rejection
SD-SC-01.expected_effect: removes an AttributeError path; no decision change when volume is present

SD-SC-02.before_semantics: execution consumes the unapproved signals while the approved ones are computed and dropped
SD-SC-02.after_semantics: one declared decision timestamp with a next-open fill; no second shift is applied
SD-SC-02.expected_effect: fixes the intent timing without changing the signal definition

SD-SC-03.before_semantics: position amplitude is 2 with no account contract attached
SD-SC-03.after_semantics: direction is normalised to 0/1 against the fixed experiment notional as sizing_mapping_v1; the legacy amplitude path is a separate labelled reproduction

SD-SC-06.before_semantics: the zero-seeded trend emits a spurious buy_signal on the first condition-true bar
SD-SC-06.after_semantics: warmup_ready stays False until 3 bars after the trend leaves its seed, so the seed jump and its comparison window can never produce a decision
SD-SC-06.expected_effect: removes one manufactured entry per series; identical treatment for every arm

attribution_rule: every difference must map to a semantic delta. A legacy entry that falls inside the canonical warmup window is attributed to the readiness repairs; an unattributed difference is a defect in the adapter, not a result.
claim_boundary: the legacy tier is diagnostic and in-sample only. Neither side is a performance claim, and a canonical result is never compared against a legacy number as if they were arms.
